faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (megaphone vergibt je Abruf eine request_event_id, megaphone haengt ein timetoken an, Adresse traegt eine session_id, kein ETag und Cache-Control "max-age=0, no-cache, no-store", Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst megaphone.fm) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: Two suitcases found on a roadside in Wisconsin reveal a former police officer's dark…
kurzfassung: Roadside workers in a small Wisconsin town discovered two suitcases containing the decomposing remains of two women. Investigators traced the victims to an online BDSM community and linked both deaths to a former police officer named Stephen Zelich. Zelich was eventually convicted of the murders and sentenced to decades in prison.
stichpunkte: Roadside workers in Geneva, Wisconsin, discover two heavy suitcases containing human remains.
Investigators identify one of the victims as Laura Simonson through family DNA and tattoo records.
A hotel surveillance video places Simonson with an unknown man who is later identified as former police officer Stephen Zelich.
Zelich operated online under the username Mr. Handcuffs within a BDSM community.
Police search Zelich's apartment and find BDSM equipment as well as evidence linking him to the crimes.
During interrogation, Zelich confesses to killing Simonson and casually mentions a second victim, Jenny Gomez.
Zelich reveals he kept Gomez's body in his refrigerator for over a year before moving both victims to his car trunk.
Zelich is convicted of multiple counts of homicide and hiding corpses, ensuring he will spend the rest of his life behind bars.

clips.hook: A quiet town upended by a grim discovery
clips.text: A quiet vacation destination is profoundly shaken when the gruesome roadside discovery makes national headlines.

clips.hook: Confronting a former officer over intimidation
clips.text: Law enforcement questions a fellow officer about aggressive and intimidating behavior toward local women.

clips.hook: An eerily calm suspect during interrogation
clips.text: Detectives express astonishment at how relaxed and unfazed the suspect appears while discussing his online alias.

clips.hook: A chilling revelation about storing a victim
clips.text: Investigators explain the grim realization that a household appliance was used to preserve a body for many months.

beschreibung:
Human remains are found abandoned in two suitcases, leaving a community shocked and searching for answers. A dating profile on a BDSM site and DNA evidence help police solve the gruesome murders.
